NumericalError: GPU GLM did not produce a reliable fit: IRLS did not converge within 25 iterations in float32. This is expected for log-link families (Poisson/Gamma) at large sample sizes, where float32 Cholesky on the normal equations is unstable (especially on Apple Silicon / MPS, which has no float64).
Options:
  - Use backend='cpu' for a correct double-precision fit (slower)
  - Use a ridge-penalized fit (a different, better-conditioned estimator)
  - Pass force=True to return the float32 GPU fit anyway (fast, but may be inaccurate / unstable)
